name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses match the task. 'Take the key, then open the door' is captured by the hard Existence(door_open) with hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), which together force the key to be taken without a redundant Existence(has_door_key). 'After that, try to pick up the box' is captured by the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) (the order word 'after that' stays hard while 'try to' scopes only the box pickup) plus the soft Existence(target_picked_up), which correctly leaves FINAL_STATES reachable without the soft goal.
